label: Simplified ITB rules for demo
note: Values from CLAUDE.md §4, each with its source (CLAUDE.md §11). Never invent a policy number; anything else is labelled assumption.

obligation.description: A prime must do business in Canada equal to the value of the contract awarded over the life of the contract.

thresholds.description: Applies to defence and Coast Guard procurements over $100M not subject to trade agreements or where the national security exception is invoked; $25M–$100M are reviewed for possible application (raised from $20M).

credit_measure.description: Credit is measured in Canadian Content Value (CCV).

smb_requirement_example.description: Generally 15% of the ITB obligation must involve SMBs.

direct_indirect.excess: Excess credit can be applied elsewhere.

value_proposition.description: Set per procurement; generally at least 10% of the bid score (Gowling WLG, secondary).

banking.description: Banked activity may generally be kept up to 10 years (Gowling, secondary); banked credit may cover at most 50% of the obligation (model terms §12.1).

multipliers.description: Regular work 1x, SME direct work 2x, eligible skills and training 5x, Indigenous workforce development 10x. The overview says the policy 'will provide' / 'may receive'; other multipliers exist (4x/5x Strategic Investment, Canadian Company Boost).
multipliers.note: Model terms §7.5.3 (cash) and §7.5.4.1 (25% cap). The cap is informational: the demo ledger does not enforce it yet.

values.description: Sponsorship costs for apprentices in a recognized apprenticeship program
Certification for a Canadian citizen or permanent resident by a recognized trade body
Contribution to a skills program through a registered charity or nonprofit
Tuition, course fees and travel incurred in Canada

authority.description: ITB authority moved to the Defence Investment Agency on July 16, 2026.

controlled_goods.description: Controlled technical data is itself a controlled good. `controlled=true` means the job involves controlled goods or controlled technical data. Shieldworks never stores drawings. A controlled job may only go to a CGP-registered shop.

cpcsc_level_1.description: 13 controls, self-assessed, no public registry. Always a shop-declared field. In select defence contracts from summer 2026; Level 2 from spring 2027.

quality_and_process_certs.description: ISO, AS9100, Nadcap, CWB: record source, verified_at and status.

assumptions.description: SMB progress counts the CCV of SME work before multipliers.
credit = value_cad x ccv_pct x multiplier; funded training has ccv_pct 1.0.
Demo simplification: SME = under 500 employees. Official: SMB ≤250 FTE (≤500 with affiliates); Small Mid-Cap within 5 years of exceeding 250 FTE (model terms §1.1.41–1.1.42).

why_now.note: Informational: sourced figures for a UI panel; not read by the engine.
